ownerStatement: On 22 November 2026, repeat98 approved the exact Grain 0.1.2-experimental package in PR #1989 after review of the MKI report and the outstanding CPU, timing, memory and MIDI measurements. The owner's response was “Approve f961b458 with those limits and push”.
reason: Package f961b458deb9f93bad68435630b4c55110d3d0ef732bdfc7886df461a6250f66. On an MKI running OS 1.40C and official base 6d23e888, the author reported that the seven-module set loaded, the pitch control, sample edges, pool and audition worked, and the saved Grain sound and settings returned after a power cycle. With 24-bit stereo, PTCH +24 and DENS and SPRY at maximum, the stock meter showed 70–71% on the kick and 68–69% on the longer sample. The baseline was 49.5% stopped. The 17-point meter charge therefore lacks a matched playing Flex comparison on this build. Short-loop render skips, worst-case chip timing, complete memory bounds, and complete MIDI stress counts remain unmeasured for this build. Static runtime memory is 31,808 bytes. Earlier performance records retain their original provenance. The 0.1.2 captures and tutorial go through the release documentation checks.
